единицы.утверждение_en: Footnote 1 (water cycle infographic): "High-quality flat lay photography creating a DIY infographic that simply explains how the water cycle works, arranged on a clean, light gray textured background. The visual story flows from left to right in clear steps. Simple, clean black arrows are hand-drawn onto the background to guide the viewer's eye. The overall mood is educational, modern, and easy to understand. The image is shot from a top-down, bird's-eye view with soft, even lighting that minimizes shadows and keeps the focus on the process."
единицы.цитата: High-quality flat lay photography creating a DIY infographic that simply explains how the water cycle works, arranged on a clean, light gray textured background. The visual story flows from left to right in clear steps. Simple, clean black arrows are hand-drawn onto the background to guide the viewer's eye. The overall mood is educational, modern, and easy to understand. The image is shot from a top-down, bird's-eye view with soft, even lighting that minimizes shadows and keeps the focus on the process.
единицы.раздел: Сноски с промптами (Read the prompts) — 1 Water Cycle
единицы.заметка: Порядок: жанр съёмки ('High-quality flat lay photography') → что за инфографика и тема → фон → направление повествования ('flows from left to right in clear steps') → навигация взгляда (нарисованные стрелки) → настроение → ракурс ('top-down, bird's-eye view') и свет ('soft, even lighting that minimizes shadows') с целью ('keeps the focus on the process').

единицы.утверждение_en: Footnote 2 (cloud types triptych): "Triptych infographic comparing three types of clouds: Cumulus, Stratus, and Cirrus. Each panel shows the cloud type in a dramatic sky with a bold label. High-contrast comic style. AR: 16:9"
единицы.цитата: Triptych infographic comparing three types of clouds: Cumulus, Stratus, and Cirrus. Each panel shows the cloud type in a dramatic sky with a bold label. High-contrast comic style. AR: 16:9
единицы.раздел: Сноски с промптами (Read the prompts) — 2 Cloud Infographic
единицы.заметка: Компактная формула: формат раскладки ('Triptych infographic') + предмет сравнения и перечень элементов + что в каждой панели ('dramatic sky with a bold label') + стиль ('High-contrast comic style') + соотношение сокращённо 'AR: 16:9'.

единицы.утверждение_en: Footnote 3 (real place in an art style, with search-first instruction): "Create an image of Museum Clos Lucé. In the style of bright colored Synthetic Cubism. No text. Your plan is to first search for visual references, and generate after. Aspect ratio 16:9"
единицы.цитата: Create an image of Museum Clos Lucé. In the style of bright colored Synthetic Cubism. No text. Your plan is to first search for visual references, and generate after. Aspect ratio 16:9
единицы.раздел: Сноски с промптами (Read the prompts) — 3 Cubism
единицы.заметка: Структура: конкретный реальный объект по имени → стиль (движение в искусстве) → запрет текста ('No text') → явный план действий для модели ('Your plan is to first search for visual references, and generate after') → формат. Пример использования поискового граундинга по изображениям прямо из текста промпта.

единицы.утверждение_en: Footnote 4, Prompt 1 (text sign): "An intimate, naturalistic cinematic close-up reveals a small, intricately illustrated sign made of recycled material, showing drawings of local birds and flowers. Delicate script below reads: "Native Wildlife: Please Observe from a Distance." Soft, diffused light filters through the leaves of a nearby fern, casting gentle shadows. The background is a soft blur of vibrant green foliage, emphasizing respect for the delicate ecosystem."
единицы.цитата: An intimate, naturalistic cinematic close-up reveals a small, intricately illustrated sign made of recycled material, showing drawings of local birds and flowers. Delicate script below reads: "Native Wildlife: Please Observe from a Distance." Soft, diffused light filters through the leaves of a nearby fern, casting gentle shadows. The background is a soft blur of vibrant green foliage, emphasizing respect for the delicate ecosystem.
единицы.раздел: Сноски с промптами (Read the prompts) — 4 Wildlife Sign (Prompt 1)
единицы.заметка: Порядок: план и характер ('intimate, naturalistic cinematic close-up') → объект и материал → изображения на нём → тип шрифта и точный текст в кавычках ('Delicate script below reads: "..."') → свет с источником ('filters through the leaves of a nearby fern') → фон ('soft blur') → смысл/настроение.

единицы.утверждение_en: Footnote 4, Prompt 2 (follow-up localization turn): "Take this concept and localize it to an Indian setting, including translation of all the text to Hindi"
единицы.цитата: Take this concept and localize it to an Indian setting, including translation of all the text to Hindi
единицы.раздел: Сноски с промптами (Read the prompts) — 4 Wildlife Sign (Prompt 2)
единицы.заметка: Второй ход после генерации: 'this concept' отсылает к предыдущему результату; две операции — смена культурного окружения ('an Indian setting') и перевод всего текста ('all the text to Hindi'). Демонстрирует многоходовую локализацию.

единицы.утверждение_en: Footnote 5 (14 references): "Create an image of these 14 characters and items having fun at the farm. The overall atmosphere is fun, silly and joyful. It is strictly important to keep identity consistent of all the 14 characters and items."
единицы.цитата: Create an image of these 14 characters and items having fun at the farm. The overall atmosphere is fun, silly and joyful. It is strictly important to keep identity consistent of all the 14 characters and items.
единицы.раздел: Сноски с промптами (Read the prompts) — 5 Farm
единицы.заметка: Структура: указание на входы с числом ('these 14 characters and items') + действие и место + атмосфера + приоритетное требование ('It is strictly important to keep identity consistent'). Число 14 совпадает с заявленным пределом объектов.

единицы.утверждение_en: Footnote 6 (multi-image story): "Create a funny 6 part story with these 3 fluffy friends building a tree house. The story is thrilling throughout with emotional highs and lows and is ending in a happy moment. Keep the attire and identity consistent of all 3 characters, but their expressions and angles should vary throughout all 6 images. Make sure to only have one of each character in each image. Generate 6 images one at a time. Each image should be a separate output in 16:9 format."
единицы.цитата: Create a funny 6 part story with these 3 fluffy friends building a tree house. The story is thrilling throughout with emotional highs and lows and is ending in a happy moment. Keep the attire and identity consistent of all 3 characters, but their expressions and angles should vary throughout all 6 images. Make sure to only have one of each character in each image. Generate 6 images one at a time. Each image should be a separate output in 16:9 format.
единицы.раздел: Сноски с промптами (Read the prompts) — 6 Treehouse
единицы.заметка: Структура: формат серии ('6 part story') + персонажи с входов ('these 3 fluffy friends') + сюжет → драматургия (highs and lows, happy ending) → что сохранять (attire and identity) и что менять (expressions and angles) → запрет дублей ('only have one of each character in each image') → способ выдачи ('Generate 6 images one at a time', 'separate output in 16:9 format').

единицы.утверждение_en: Footnote 7 (long descriptive landscape): "This aerial shot captures a dramatic, misty landscape, likely a valley or glen, … The overall impression is one of serene, untamed wilderness, hinting at the rugged beauty of places like the Scottish Highlands or the Lake District." (full text in quote).
единицы.цитата: This aerial shot captures a dramatic, misty landscape, likely a valley or glen, characterized by rolling, verdant hills and a winding river or loch. The photography style leans towards a moody and atmospheric aesthetic, emphasizing the grandeur and isolation of nature. The camera angle is high, looking down into the valley, providing a sweeping panoramic view that highlights the immense scale of the surroundings. The dominant colors are various shades of deep green, ranging from lush emerald in the foreground fields to darker, more muted tones on the distant mountains. The water, a central feature, appears as a serene, dark blue-grey, reflecting the overcast sky. The sky itself is a blend of grey and white, heavily laden with clouds and mist that cling to the mountain peaks, creating a soft, diffused lighting style. This natural, soft light minimizes harsh shadows and enhances the overall ethereal feel of the scene. The subject is a majestic natural landscape. In the foreground, a darker body of water curves around a patch of bright green fields, bordered by scattered trees and shrubs. A narrow, winding road snakes through the green hills on the right side of the frame, disappearing into the distance. Further into the valley, a larger, lighter blue-grey body of water stretches between towering, green-clad mountains. These mountains rise steeply on both sides, their peaks shrouded in the low-hanging mist, creating a sense of depth and mystery. The overall impression is one of serene, untamed wilderness, hinting at the rugged beauty of places like the Scottish Highlands or the Lake District.
единицы.раздел: Сноски с промптами (Read the prompts) — 7 Valley
единицы.заметка: Промпт написан как подробное описание готовой фотографии (~260 слов, 'This aerial shot captures…', 'likely a valley or glen'). Порядок: тип кадра и сцена → стиль фотографии и настроение → положение камеры ('high, looking down') → доминирующие цвета по планам → вода и небо → свет ('soft, diffused lighting') и его эффект → передний план → правая часть кадра → дальний план → общее впечатление и отсылки к реальным местам.

единицы.утверждение_en: Footnote 8 (stylized fashion portrait, shown in different aspect ratios): "Cinematic still, evoking a vibrant, dreamlike quality often found in highly stylized musical dramas or whimsical comedies, … imbued with an almost surreal, pop-art energy." (full text in quote).
единицы.цитата: Cinematic still, evoking a vibrant, dreamlike quality often found in highly stylized musical dramas or whimsical comedies, with a composition style reminiscent of a master of bold, graphic imagery. The camera is positioned slightly low, looking up at the subject, emphasizing their commanding presence and the dramatic flair of their outfit. The color palette is exceptionally bold and high-contrast, dominated by electric blue and shocking pink, with a bright yellow accent. The background is a solid, uniform cerulean blue, providing a stark, graphic backdrop that makes the subject pop. The subject is a young, dark-skinned individual with tightly coiled hair, wearing an incredibly striking suit. The suit's fabric features an audacious pattern of swirling, wavy lines in electric blue, interspersed with large, concentric circles in hot pink, overlapping and radiating outwards. The tailored blazer has wide lapels and bell sleeves, worn over a sharply pressed yellow collared shirt. The matching trousers are wide-legged, dramatically flaring out towards the ground, with sharp creases down the front. The individual wears bright yellow, heart-shaped sunglasses and large, pink, circular earrings. Their hands are placed on their hips in a confident, almost defiant pose, and their gaze, though hidden behind the sunglasses, projects an aura of cool assurance. The ambiance is one of high fashion, playfulness, and unadulterated self-expression, imbued with an almost surreal, pop-art energy.
единицы.раздел: Сноски с промптами (Read the prompts) — 8 Portrait
единицы.заметка: ~220 слов. Порядок: тип кадра и жанровая отсылка (без имён: 'a master of bold, graphic imagery') → камера ('slightly low, looking up') и зачем → палитра с названными цветами → фон ('solid, uniform cerulean blue') → субъект → одежда деталь за деталью → аксессуары → поза и взгляд → общая атмосфера. Подпись: один промпт показан в разных соотношениях сторон.

единицы.утверждение_en: Footnote 9 (AI Mode in Search, world knowledge): "Create a pencil sketch of a pufferfish nest. Not a clean digital drawing but something with visible pencil strokes and that dusty graphite look"
единицы.цитата: Create a pencil sketch of a pufferfish nest. Not a clean digital drawing but something with visible pencil strokes and that dusty graphite look
единицы.раздел: Сноски с промптами (Read the prompts) — 9 AI Mode in Search
единицы.заметка: Структура: медиум + редкий реальный объект ('pufferfish nest') + уточнение стиля через противопоставление ('Not a clean digital drawing but ... visible pencil strokes and that dusty graphite look'). Alt: сравнение менее точного и более точного (геометрическая научная схема) эскиза — демонстрация знания мира.

единицы.утверждение_en: Footnote 10 (Flow, subject preservation): four prompts share a fixed style prefix "35mm soft blur, vibrant colors, soft light." followed by a scene sentence that places "this baby kangaroo" (reference character) in a location with an action and outfit and positions "this hat" (reference object), optionally ending with "motion blur" — Boat, Cafe, Hotel and Castle variants.
единицы.цитата: Boat Prompt: 35mm soft blur, vibrant colors, soft light. Sailing at the ocean this baby kangaroo wearing a lilac raincoat sailing, motion blur, this hat is sitting messy on the boat. Cafe Prompt: 35mm soft blur, vibrant colors, soft light. Sitting on this seat of the café this baby kangaroo sipping coffee, a person sitting behind at the cafe blurred is wearing this hat. Hotel Prompt: 35mm soft blur, vibrant colors, soft light. Relaxing on the bed this baby kangaroo wearing a bathrobe relaxing, at the back there is a coat rack with this hat. Castle Prompt: 35mm soft blur, vibrant colors, soft light. Jumping inside the inflatable castle this baby kangaroo wearing this hat jumping, motion blur
единицы.раздел: Сноски с промптами (Read the prompts) — 10 Flow
единицы.заметка: Шаблон: '<камера/стиль: 35mm soft blur, vibrant colors, soft light>. <место+действие> this baby kangaroo <одежда/действие>, <где находится this hat>, <motion blur при движении>'. Варианты отличаются только сценой: лодка в океане (лиловый дождевик, шляпа лежит в лодке), кафе (пьёт кофе, шляпа на человеке сзади), отель (халат, шляпа на вешалке), надувной замок (в шляпе, прыжок). 'this' указывает на входные референсы. Грамматика телеграфная.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Photographic prompts on the page open with the shot or medium ("High-quality flat lay photography", "An intimate, naturalistic cinematic close-up", "This aerial shot", "Cinematic still", "35mm soft blur"), then describe subject and arrangement, lighting and mood, and put the aspect ratio in the text at the very end ("AR: 16:9", "Aspect ratio 16:9", "in 16:9 format").

Multi-reference prompts state what must stay fixed and what may change, with strong priority wording and anti-duplication: "It is strictly important to keep identity consistent…", "Keep the attire and identity consistent … but their expressions and angles should vary", "Make sure to only have one of each character in each image"; references are pointed to with "these/this" and their count.

For accurate depiction of a specific real subject, the page pairs Nano Banana 2’s web/image-search grounding with an explicit planning instruction in the prompt ("Your plan is to first search for visual references, and generate after").
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Сама страница не формулирует это как правило — только пример промпта и описание механизма.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Text handling in prompts: exact wording goes in quotation marks after a descriptor of the lettering ("Delicate script below reads: "…""), labels are requested generically ("with a bold label"), and unwanted text is excluded explicitly ("No text"); translation is done as a follow-up turn on the result.

The page’s prompts range from one-line instructions (pencil sketch, 2 sentences) to 220-260-word photo-caption-style descriptions; the long ones are written as descriptions of an already existing photo ("This aerial shot captures…", "likely a valley or glen") covering style, camera angle, colours by plane, light, foreground/background and overall impression.
